title: Sweet as Honey
traveler_why: Wren is the Traveler who keeps good words and turns them over, and tonight Ezekiel takes the Lord’s words all the way in, tastes them like honey, and keeps them so he can teach them by heart.
traveler_about: Wren fits tonight because she keeps good words in her heart and thinks about them. In Wren’s world today: Wren asked Dad for the very same story three nights in a row. She said the words along with him, slower each time. In the morning, over her cereal, she was still thinking about it. Just like Ezekiel eating the sweet scroll, Wren learned that Heavenly Father’s words stay sweet long after the book is closed.
